businesses.business: Life insurance, mortgages and funeral services

offering_description.value: The company underwrites life insurance for individuals and families, with an emphasis on final expenses and prepaid funeral arrangements. It originates residential mortgages for homebuyers and homeowners through its lending subsidiary. It also operates funeral homes and cemeteries that provide funeral, cremation and burial services.

primary_products.value: Final-expense and preneed life insurance; other life insurance and annuities; residential mortgage loans; cemetery plots; caskets and urns

primary_services.value: Mortgage origination; funeral arrangements and ceremonies; cremation; burial and interment

customer_segment.value: B2C: Individuals and families buying insurance or funeral arrangements, homebuyers and homeowners refinancing; B2B: Institutional purchasers of originated mortgage loans

end_markets.value: Individual life insurance; residential mortgage lending; funeral and cemetery services

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: Life insurance premiums and interest on mortgage loans held by the company; transaction or usage fees: Mortgage origination and related loan fees; other: Gains on sales of originated mortgages to institutional investors; service fees: Funeral ceremonies, cremation and interment; product sales: Burial plots, caskets and urns
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; transaction or usage fees; other; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Underwrites insurance for individuals, funds home loans and sells originated loans to institutional investors; service provider: Arranges funeral, cremation and burial services for families; asset operator: Owns and operates funeral homes and cemeteries serving local families
value_chain_position.category: financial intermediary; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: US national: Insurance and mortgage operations across multiple U.S. states, with funeral homes and cemeteries concentrated in Utah and California

specialization.value: diversified: Life insurance, residential mortgage lending, and funeral home and cemetery operations

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Independent life insurance agents; partners / resellers: Funeral homes that offer preneed insurance to families; direct sales: Mortgage loan officers working directly with borrowers; online: Online residential mortgage applications; own locations: Company-operated funeral homes and cemeteries
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; partners / resellers; direct sales; online; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance and mortgage licensing, federal consumer lending rules, and state funeral home and cemetery regulation

notes: The exact current state footprint and relative scale of the insurance and mortgage businesses are uncertain.
